description: Dept. of Local Government  Uva Province - Notify the names of the Mayors and Chairmen in Badulla and Monaragala Local Government Authorities
reasoning: This gazette contains the official publication of election results for local government authorities, specifically naming the elected Mayors and Chairmen for various Local Government Institutions in the Badulla and Monaragala districts. This content falls directly under the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which includes "Election results and declarations" and is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
